question: What qualities of the Yamunā's bank define the setting of the contemplated rāsa play?
premises: The setting is the bank of the Yamunā.
The bank is bright and cool.
inference: The rāsa play is to be visualized on the bright, cool, heat-removing bank of the Yamunā.
plain_english: Visualize this on the bright, cool bank of the Yamunā, which removes all heat.
